findings.message: All 239,904 math training answers retain Python bytes-literal wrappers (for example b'10\n'). Predictable wrapper tokens dilute NLL; this run is not a clean math benchmark.
findings.action: Tested decoder and separate prepare_v2 entry point provided; active corpus is unchanged.

findings.message: The trainer first-eight math generation check samples addition/subtraction only; other modules are absent.
findings.action: Use separate balanced audit results: 16 examples per module.

findings.message: Checkpoint 17607 scored 2/64 balanced math and 0/16 easy plus 0/16 hard Sudoku. Complete-answer reasoning remains weak at this early checkpoint.

Learned checkpoint gradients reach the concept core, but removing concept guidance changes NLL by under 0.001 in all four offline batches. Code changes affect logits only weakly; no useful concept contribution established yet.

Live logs contain only dense preclip gradient norm on the last update of each 20-step interval; sparse Engram and per-layer live gradients were never recorded. CPU checkpoint probes are labeled separately.
RBF wiring and frozen-backbone write contracts passed, but retention/transfer gains have not been measured. No RBF writes occur in this pretraining run.
